audit_method: AI-assisted desk source audit by a separate reviewing agent, using merchant menus/contact/location pages and merchant transactional ordering pages. This is not an independent human study, a blind audit or in-person confirmation.
rubric_note: The twelve-query suite was frozen before inference. Fine-grained evidence operationalization was finalized during this post-generation desk review and shared across both halves. Strict requested municipal-city scope is used; metro fit is separately noted. Crispy requires explicit crisp/crunch texture or clear dish-specific texture evidence, not frying alone. Fresh/light accepts explicitly raw/sushi/steamed menu style proxies, without actual-freshness or nutrition claims. A description can pass dish identity only when uniquely mapped to an identified real menu item, with display-name defects recorded separately.
source_limitations: Web access dates are review dates; indexed pages may have older crawl dates. An active merchant site/menu is web evidence of current venue identity, not a guarantee of current opening, stock, freshness or delivery availability. No extra application API requests were made.
